Name: Connected Signs
Author: DouziQishen
Description:
CONNECTED SIGNS

Add a personal touch to your farm with wooden noticeboards that display your own text directly in the world—no hovering required.

Label crop areas, welcome visitors, or organize shared storage with signs that fit your farm.


MAIN FEATURES

• Always-visible text
Read messages directly on the board without hovering or opening a menu.

• Expandable signs
Place sign units on the ground like fences. Adjacent units in the same horizontal row automatically connect into a wider board. Separate rows remain independent.

• Multiline text and live preview
Open the editor to write your message and preview the result before saving.

• Customizable appearance
Choose light or dark wood, four board height levels, text alignment, and automatic or fixed text size.

• Automatic text joining
Connecting boards combines their non-empty messages from left to right, separated by line breaks. Adding an empty unit simply makes the board wider.

• Adjustable connections
Select a connection boundary in the editor to split a board. Both sides retain the original message and can then be edited independently.

• Multiplayer synchronization
Sign content and edits are synchronized through the host. The host and all farmhands must install the same mod version.


REQUIREMENTS

• SMAPI 4.5.2 or later.
• Stardew Valley. The tested development version is 1.6.15.
• No Content Patcher dependency is required.


INSTALLATION

1. Install SMAPI.
2. Download and extract ConnectedSigns-0.1.10.zip.
3. Place the entire ConnectedSigns folder inside your game's Mods folder.
4. Check that the resulting path is Mods/ConnectedSigns/manifest.json.
5. Launch the game through SMAPI.

For multiplayer, install the same version on every player's computer.


HOW TO USE

1. Open the crafting menu. The recipe is unlocked automatically.
2. Craft a sign unit using 10 Wood.
3. Place units beside one another to create a wider board.
4. While holding another item or an empty hand, right-click a placed board to open the editor.
5. Enter your message, adjust the appearance, and select Save.

Press Enter while editing to add a line break.

Connection changes apply immediately and submit the current text draft. Cancel only discards changes that have not already been applied.


LANGUAGE SUPPORT

Editor labels and messages support English and Simplified Chinese. The in-game item name, crafting recipe name, and editor title currently remain in Chinese in both language modes.


COMPATIBILITY AND TESTING

Tested development environment: macOS, Stardew Valley 1.6.15, and SMAPI 4.5.2.

Windows and Linux have not yet been tested in-game. Earlier development builds received LAN and split-screen testing; a complete multiplayer regression for version 0.1.10 remains pending. Full controller navigation and all UI scaling combinations have not yet been verified.

Back up your save before installation or upgrading.

If your message does not fit, widen or raise the board, select automatic text size, or shorten the message.


UPDATING

Close the game, back up your save, and replace the existing ConnectedSigns folder with the new version. Keep only one installed copy. All multiplayer participants must update together.


REMOVING THE MOD

Do not remove the mod while your save still contains its custom items.

1. Back up your save.
2. Load the save as the host with no other players or split-screen sessions connected.
3. Run cs_export in the SMAPI console to export your sign text.
4. Run cs_convert CONFIRM to convert custom signs to vanilla signs.
5. Check inventories, chests, and other storage for remaining custom items.
6. Sleep to save, then reload with the mod still installed to verify the conversion.
7. Close the game and remove the ConnectedSigns folder.

Keep your backup and exported text. Conversion preserves your written messages in the export file, not on the vanilla signs.


CREDITS

Created by Douzi with AI-generated code and AI-assisted development.

Screenshots may include other visual mods. Lighting and environmental effects are not included in Connected Signs.


FEEDBACK

When reporting an issue, please include your mod version, operating system, game version, SMAPI log, and steps to reproduce it.

For multiplayer issues, mention whether you were the host or a farmhand. For display issues, include a screenshot and your UI scale and zoom settings.
